newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY JAN/JULY BUDGET DEF UP AT 188.9BLN FORINTS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY JAN/JULY BUDGET DEF UP AT 188.9BLN FORINTS.

text.p: Hungary accumulated a central budget deficit of 188.9 billion forints between January and July of this year, up from the January-June figure of 165 billion, the finance ministry said in a statement on Tuesday.
Central budget income for the first seven months was 1.309.9 billion forints while expenditure amounted to 1.498.8 billion forints, the statement said.
Hungary's central budget deficit for the first seven months of 1996 was 102 billion forints.
NOTE - The figures do not include one-off revenues, e.g. privatisation revenues.
